entries.source_line: std::shared_ptr<Program> Active(){Actual();auto s=OriginalNativeSourceProgramBinding().Current();Check(s.kind==NativeSourceProgramBinding::Kind::UnitGlass&&s.owner,"Glass uniform has no active source program");auto p=std::const_pointer_cast<Program>(std::static_pointer_cast<const Program>(s.owner));Check(!p->deleted&&p->context.lock().get()==this,"Glass program belongs to another/deleted source context");return p;}
